tiles.title: Agent Runs
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS agent_runs FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'agent_run'

tiles.title: Run Success Rate
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code <> 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS success_rate_pct FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'agent_run'

tiles.title: Total Tokens
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE) + CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS total_tokens FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'model_generation' AND "gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL

tiles.title: P95 Agent Latency
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_agent_ms FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'agent_run'

tiles.title: Workload Scenarios
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE("mastra.log.scenario", 'unspecified') AS scenario, body AS event, COUNT(*) AS records FROM $logs_dataset WHERE body IN ('Mastra workload started', 'Mastra workload completed', 'Mastra workload failed') GROUP BY scenario, event ORDER BY scenario, event

tiles.title: Agent Runs Over Time
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, "gen_ai.agent.name" AS agent, COUNT(*) AS runs FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'agent_run' GROUP BY time_bin, agent ORDER BY time_bin, agent

tiles.title: Reasoning Tokens
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.reasoning_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS reasoning_tokens FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'model_generation' AND "gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL

tiles.title: Input Tokens
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS input_tokens FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'model_generation' AND "gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL

tiles.title: Avg Tokens / Call
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE) + CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS avg_tokens_per_call FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'model_generation' AND "gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL

tiles.title: Token Usage Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT time_bin, token_type, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM (
          SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, 'input' AS token_type, CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS tokens FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'model_generation' AND "gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL
          UNION ALL
          SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, 'output' AS token_type, CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS tokens FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'model_generation' AND "gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL
          UNION ALL
          SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, 'reasoning' AS token_type, CAST("gen_ai.usage.reasoning_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS tokens FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'model_generation' AND "gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL
        ) token_events GROUP BY time_bin, token_type ORDER BY time_bin, token_type

tiles.title: Tool Error Details
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT p_timestamp, "gen_ai.tool.name" AS tool, "error.type" AS error_type, COALESCE("error.message", span_status_message) AS error_message, "gen_ai.tool.call.arguments" AS arguments, span_trace_id, ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 2) AS duration_ms FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'tool_call' AND span_status_code = 2 ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Model & Agent Economics
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT "gen_ai.agent.name" AS agent, COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", "gen_ai.response.model") AS model, "gen_ai.provider.name" AS provider, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE)) AS input_tokens, SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE)) AS output_tokens, SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.reasoning_tokens" AS DOUBLE)) AS reasoning_tokens, ROUND(SUM(agent_cost(CASE WHEN "gen_ai.provider.name" LIKE 'openai%' THEN 'openai' ELSE "gen_ai.provider.name" END, COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", "gen_ai.response.model"), CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)), 6) AS cost_usd, ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0), 2) AS avg_ms FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'model_generation' AND "gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY agent, model, provider ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

tiles.title: Agent Latency Over Time
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, "gen_ai.agent.name" AS agent, ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0), 2) AS avg_ms, ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'agent_run' GROUP BY time_bin, agent ORDER BY time_bin, agent

tiles.title: Latency by Agent
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT "gen_ai.agent.name" AS agent, ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0), 2) AS avg_ms, ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.50), 2) AS p50_ms, ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'agent_run' GROUP BY agent ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

tiles.title: Operation P95 Latency
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT "mastra.span.type" AS operation, COUNT(*) AS spans, ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0), 2) AS avg_ms, ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY operation ORDER BY p95_ms DESC LIMIT 15

tiles.title: Slowest Agent Runs
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT p_timestamp, "gen_ai.agent.name" AS agent, span_trace_id, ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 3) AS duration_s, CASE WHEN span_status_code = 2 THEN 'error' ELSE 'success' END AS outcome, SUBSTRING("mastra.agent_run.input", 1, 220) AS input_preview FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'agent_run' ORDER BY span_duration_ns DESC LIMIT 25

tiles.title: Log Severity Distribution
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE(severity_text, p_log_category, 'UNSPECIFIED') AS severity, COUNT(*) AS records FROM $logs_dataset GROUP BY severity ORDER BY records DESC

tiles.title: Logs Over Time
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, COALESCE(severity_text, p_log_category, 'UNSPECIFIED') AS severity, COUNT(*) AS records FROM $logs_dataset GROUP BY time_bin, severity ORDER BY time_bin, severity

tiles.title: Error Logs
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT p_timestamp, severity_text, body, COALESCE("mastra.log.agent", "mastra.log.agentName", 'unknown') AS agent, "mastra.log.scenario" AS scenario, "mastra.log.tool" AS tool, "mastra.log.error" AS error, trace_id, span_id FROM $logs_dataset WHERE COALESCE(severity_text, p_log_category) IN ('ERROR', 'FATAL') ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Recent Mastra Logs
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT p_timestamp, severity_text, body, COALESCE("mastra.log.agent", "mastra.log.agentName", 'unknown') AS agent, "mastra.log.scenario" AS scenario, trace_id, span_id FROM $logs_dataset ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Recent Spans
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT p_timestamp, span_name, "mastra.span.type" AS span_type, "gen_ai.operation.name" AS operation, "gen_ai.agent.name" AS agent, "gen_ai.tool.name" AS tool, CASE WHEN span_status_code = 2 THEN 'error' ELSE 'ok' END AS status, ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 2) AS duration_ms, span_trace_id, span_span_id, span_parent_span_id FROM $traces_dataset ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 150

tiles.title: Metric Inventory
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT metric_name, metric_type, metric_unit, COUNT(*) AS samples, MIN(p_timestamp) AS first_seen, MAX(p_timestamp) AS last_seen, COUNT(DISTINCT __series_hash) AS series FROM $metrics_dataset GROUP BY metric_name, metric_type, metric_unit ORDER BY metric_name

tiles.title: Error Spans
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS error_spans FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_status_code = 2

tiles.title: Model Calls
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS model_calls FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'model_generation'

tiles.title: Tool Calls
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tool_calls FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'tool_call'

tiles.title: Estimated Cost
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(agent_cost(CASE WHEN "gen_ai.provider.name" LIKE 'openai%' THEN 'openai' ELSE "gen_ai.provider.name" END, COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", "gen_ai.response.model"), CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)), 0), 6) AS estimated_cost_usd FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'model_generation' AND "gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL

tiles.title: Agent Summary
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT "gen_ai.agent.name" AS agent, COUNT(*) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN span_status_code = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code <> 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS success_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0), 2) AS avg_ms, ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'agent_run' GROUP BY agent ORDER BY runs DESC

tiles.title: Span Volume by Type
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE("mastra.span.type", 'unknown') AS span_type, COUNT(*) AS spans FROM $traces_dataset GROUP BY span_type ORDER BY spans DESC LIMIT 15

tiles.title: Output Tokens
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS output_tokens FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'model_generation' AND "gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL

tiles.title: Estimated Cost Over Time
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, ROUND(SUM(agent_cost(CASE WHEN "gen_ai.provider.name" LIKE 'openai%' THEN 'openai' ELSE "gen_ai.provider.name" END, COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", "gen_ai.response.model"), CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)), 6) AS cost_usd FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'model_generation' AND "gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Tool Calls Over Time
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, "gen_ai.tool.name" AS tool, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'tool_call' GROUP BY time_bin, tool ORDER BY time_bin, tool

tiles.title: Tool Calls by Outcome
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT "gen_ai.tool.name" AS tool, CASE WHEN span_status_code = 2 THEN 'error' ELSE 'success' END AS outcome, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'tool_call' GROUP BY tool, outcome ORDER BY calls DESC

tiles.title: Tool Latency
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT "gen_ai.tool.name" AS tool, COUNT(*) AS calls, ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0), 2) AS avg_ms, ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN span_status_code = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'tool_call' GROUP BY tool ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

tiles.title: Trace Summary
Model Call Details
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT p_timestamp, "gen_ai.agent.name" AS agent, COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", "gen_ai.response.model") AS model, "gen_ai.provider.name" AS provider, CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS input_tokens, CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS output_tokens, CAST("gen_ai.usage.reasoning_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS reasoning_tokens, ROUND(agent_cost(CASE WHEN "gen_ai.provider.name" LIKE 'openai%' THEN 'openai' ELSE "gen_ai.provider.name" END, COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", "gen_ai.response.model"), CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp), 6) AS cost_usd, ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 2) AS duration_ms, "gen_ai.response.finish_reasons" AS finish_reason, span_trace_id FROM $traces_dataset WHERE "mastra.span.type" = 'model_generation' AND "gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
